name: @firfi/voila-cli
description: Command line interface for Voila grocery workflows

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/clean-package-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs --external:playwright --external:chromium-bidi/* && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --external:playwright --external:chromium-bidi/* && esbuild src/bin.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/bin.cjs --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' --external:playwright --external:chromium-bidi/*

author: firfi
